long_biography.plain_text:
Two linked companies shaped Luca Regusci's career. His grandfather Cesare established Regusci SA around building materials and heating coal; his father Orazio later created Reco SA for sanitary products. When Luca took charge, he separated their Bellinzona premises, moving Regusci SA while preserving Reco's original base, and developed the pair as complementary distributors.

The companies ultimately entered CRH Gétaz Holding, a wider Swiss building-products group. Regusci presented the combination as a route to continuity and further growth. He remained general manager and a board member, with CRH assigning him acquisition work in Ticino and nearby northern Italy.
